ready_slots.description: Required JSON, Markdown, and artifact-manifest outputs are checked before the package is treated as release evidence.
Generated validation-package artifacts are bound by path-independent SHA256 rows when present.
Package manifest hash binds output presence, required sections, artifact rows, and reproduction commands.
Validation-package sections for known answers, fixtures, FP/FN notes, independent validation, QC, and package assessment are declared.
Reproduction commands are emitted so an operator can regenerate the package and commercial-readiness report.
Trusted validation-package diff status is explicit; a generated package is not treated as independently validated by default.

blocking_slots.required_evidence: trusted validation-package manifest diff covering output presence, artifact set hash, package hash, and required sections
unit/integration/build/smoke command logs attached to the package for the shipped release
release artifact hashes, platform smoke results, and dependency/SBOM evidence attached
independent review or lab signoff tying the validation package to the shipped build

validation_package_report_grade_validati.report_use_warning: A generated validation package is internal release evidence only until test logs, release evidence, trusted package diff, and independent review are attached.

platform_uplift_actionability.operator_rule: Run Mac-local QC whenever possible, but do not mark commercial_grade true until the Windows/E01/trusted-tool/large-case/independent-review evidence is attached and passes.

score_strategy: Do not raise commercial-grade gates by wording alone.
Prioritize critical parser depth, then validation/legal, then performance and UX bottlenecks.
Attach real corpus, cross-tool diff, benchmark, or operator evidence before claiming commercial parity.
Use five-item batches so every uplift produces code, tests, docs, validation evidence, and a commit.

large_data_strategy.rule: Large evidence must be streamed, checkpointed, cursor-paged, and hash-referenced; UI and reports must never require loading all rows.
large_data_strategy.parser_runtime: Keep Python as orchestration/API/UI glue; move hot EVTX/Registry/ESE/MFT/USN/hash/OCR workers toward Rust or isolated native subprocesses.
large_data_strategy.storage: Use SQLite/PostgreSQL for case metadata, FTS/Tantivy-style indexes for search, and Parquet/DuckDB-style sidecars for large analytical outputs when needed.
large_data_strategy.api: Every massive table/search/timeline endpoint should expose cursor tokens, limits, total estimates, and snapshot warnings.
large_data_strategy.ui: Use virtualized result tables, lazy previews, dedupe collapse, and explicit loading/progress states.
large_data_strategy.proof: Publish benchmark JSON with hardware profile, evidence size, record count, wall time, peak memory, p95 latency, failures, and resume behavior.

all_items.title: Native EVTX BinXML full parsing
all_items.body: Acceptance: decode binary EVTX records into full Event/System/EventData/UserData fields without relying on external exports; current native rows expose record metadata, strings, integrity, explicit `evtx_binxml_status`, first-pass BinXML token scans for fragment headers/elements/attributes/value text/template headers, inline String/ANSI/integer/bool/float/GUID/SID/FILETIME/SYSTIME/binary scalar decoding, bounded nested `BinXmlType` payload parsing through `evtx-nested-binxml-value-v1` hashes/previews/field maps/token counts, TemplateInstance IDs, TemplateInstance value spec/value decoding for common scalar types, substitution value fields, promoted `Event/System`, `EventData`/named `Data`, duplicate-preserving ordered EventData sequences, grouped EventData values by name, and `UserData` fields, normalized EventID/provider/channel/computer/level/timestamp/process/thread/user-SID/command pivots, rendered previews, decoded value-type counts, BinXML field maps, `eventlog-chunk` structure rows for native chunk bounds/checksum observations, and `commercial_uplift_evidence` that fixes #1 source refs, validation matrix pass/fail IDs, commercial blockers, and large-data reader limits. Remaining commercial gap: complete provider-specific BinXML grammar coverage and independent corpus validation.

known_limits: RapidTriage is still a triage/review tool, not a full AXIOM/WISDOM replacement.
Native acquisition, deep carving, signed installers, and legal validation require external release processes.
Some direct image formats are detected but require mounting/exporting or external tools before scanning.
OCR, perceptual hashing, APK risk flags, memory imports, and cloud imports are analyst triage aids.

release_decision.meaning: Internal 100-point target is met when these checks are run and attached to a release.
external_requirements: Independent legal validation remains an organization process, not a CLI guarantee.
Signed Windows/macOS installers require release infrastructure outside the source tree.
Commercial support SLAs and training material must be maintained by the operator/vendor.
